verdict.rationale: Typesense Cloud documents an official MCP server. Through it, a connected AI agent can create and configure clusters, build collections, index data, tune search and read metrics, all from a conversation. That covers operating the product with natural-language commands. The docs also mention built-in Natural Language Search via LLM integrations, though that serves end-user querying rather than operating the product. Missing for 10: evidence that natural-language operation works for self-hosted (non-Cloud) deployments, in-depth documentation of the MCP tool coverage, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
